system.description:
“When the blade finds the seam between extended muscle, sinew, and bone...anybody — no matter how sturdy — can be cleaved. No matter how unconventional the opponent may be the principles behind decapacitation still hold. Know the body's framework, and weave into the openings. Such is the way of Yamada Asaemon…”

—Yamada Asaemon Sagiri, Jigokuraku

Single-Swing Style

Tag: Setting Agnostic, Creator: KadenUchiha

The Yamada are sword testers and executioners. Some time ago, a fraction of their clan broke rank, and crossed the sea, landing on the shores of the Land of Water. They retained their original work as executioners for the Daimyo, and some even officially joining the Shinobi Military. As part of their training, they spend a great deal of time deepening their understanding of the human body, it is not uncommon to find a Yamada working in the morgue dissecting corpses to better understand the ways to slice a human. When performing executions, the Yamada clan's doctrine is that the condemned should not feel any pain or emotions coming from their swords and that they must try to hone their skills to perform an ideal cut.

Yamada Traits

Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Cha, +1 Str or Dex

Speed: 30 feet

Skill Proficiency: Martial Arts, Medicine

Tool Proficiency: Medicine Kit

Weapon Proficiency: Tanto, Broadsword, Katana, Odachi & Chokuto.

Single-Swing Practitioner: The Yamada Clan has access to a separate list of Jutsu unique to their Clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the Normal jutsu list(s).

Hijutsu Flexibility: Yamada Clan Hijutsu can use either Strength or Wisdom as its casting ability score.

Anatomical Studies: The Yamada clans skill in medicine, allows them to use their knowledge on physical anatomy to foretell an enemies actions. They can use Medicine, in place of Illusions, Martial Arts or Ninshou to take the Read the Enemy action.

| #### Art Source / All Art is sourced from official sources found for the Hells Paradise series, by Yuji Kaku |

Yamada Features

Tameshi Itto-ryu

1st Level Clan Feature

Drawing your weapon is a show that peaceful options have been exhausted. With your weapon drawn you steady yourself and settle into an almost motionless stance, giving each foe that stands against you a verdict of guilt and execution. While in this stance, if you are wielding a weapon listed under your Weapon Proficiency trait, it becomes known as your Executioners Instrument. While in this Bukijutsu stance, you gain the following benefits:

You can use your Hijutsu Flexibility ability mod in place of strength weapon attacks with Executioners Instrument weapons.

Yamada clan Hijutsu you cast with your Executioners Instrument can use the Ideal Cut ability listed. Beginning at 7th level, you cast can use the Tao ability listed. If you use the Tao ability, you cannot use the Ideal Cut ability, and vice versa.

When you take the Attack action with an Executioners Instrument, you can use the Empty Blade attack.

Empty Blade: You can forgo all additional attacks beyond the first one as part of this Attack Action. When you do, roll a number of d6’s equal to the forgone attacks, plus 1 if the affected creature is Severed. If you roll a 5 or 6 with a d6, you can deal additional damage equal to your [Weapon Damage], which is not multiplied as part of a critical hit.

Beginning at 7th level, if you do not have the Extra Attack class feature, you can attack twice while in this stance when you take the Attack action.

Asaemon Disciplines

3rd Level Clan Feature

The Yamada clan have strict training regimens enforcing their clansmen to be proficient in more than just the blade. They must also be skilled in a variety of other things to help them find some semblance of balance within themselves. You can select two of the listed disciplines to gain proficiency in. You gain another discipline at 7th and 15th levels. You use your highest jutsu attack bonus or save DC for effects that call for a saving throw.

Anatomist

You gain a rank of Mastery to Survival. This increases to two ranks of Mastery at 7th level and three ranks at 15th level.

Once per turn, when you deal damage with an Executioners Instrument against a Bruised creature. You can force them to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they lose the listed condition and instead they gain the Severed condition.

Blind Blade

While you can hear and mold chakra, You gain 10 feet of Blindsight. This increases to 15 feet at 7th level and 20 feet at 15th level. Attacks you make within your blindsight range cannot be made at disadvantage.

Carpenter

You gain a rank of Mastery to Crafting. This increases to two ranks of Mastery at 7th level and three ranks at 15th level.

Once per turn, when you deal [Weapon Damage] to a Construct or Structure, and you use the 3rd bullet point effect of your Tameshi Itto-Ryu stance, you can roll 2 additional d6’s.

Edge Sharpening

You methodically sharpen every tool you find yourself in possession of. Over the course of a short rest, you take your Executioners Instrument and one weapon from each willing allied creature and work to sharpen or balance them. At the conclusion of your rest, the first time you roll initiative, all of your sharpened weapons come to fruition. Until the conclusion of this combat, you gain a rank of Mastery to your [Weapon Damage]. This increases to two ranks of Mastery at 11th level.

Once you sharpen weapons in this way, you cannot do so again until you complete another rest.

Interrogator

You gain a rank of Mastery to Intimidation. This increases to two ranks of Mastery at 7th level and three ranks at 15th level.

When you take the Demoralize skill action, the opposing creature does not make an opposing check, but instead you make your check vs the opposing creatures Wisdom DC.

Additionally, by beating the target creatures Wisdom DC by 10 or more, if they are a Standard or Minion classed adversary, they drop their weapons, if any and must flee until the end of their next turn.

Judge

You gain a rank of Mastery on saving throws vs gaining the Charmed, Confused, Demoralized and Dazed conditions. This increases to two ranks of Mastery at 11th level.

Lawyer

You gain a rank of Mastery to Investigation. This increases to two ranks of Mastery at 7th level and three ranks at 15th level.

Once per turn, when you deal damage with an Executioners Instrument against a creature with at least one rank of Confused or Dazed. You can force them to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they lose the listed condition and instead gain the Severed condition.

Politician

You gain a rank of Mastery to Deception. This increases to two ranks of Mastery at 7th level and three ranks at 15th level.

When you take the Create Diversion skill action, you may, as part of that action, make one Weapon attack against one target creature you can reach. On a successful check, you can instead make two weapon attacks.

Surgeon

You gain a rank of Mastery to Medicine. This increases to two ranks of Mastery at 7th level and three ranks at 15th level. Once per turn, when you deal damage with an Executioners Instrument against a creature with at least one rank of Bleed. You can force them to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they lose the listed condition and instead they gain the Severed condition.

Assessment of Tao

7th Level Clan Feature

The secrets of Tao are found in a scroll in the Yamada clans storerooms. Manipulating Yin and Yang Chakra allows one to tap into a special form of energy called Tao. You’ve become able to sense the latent Tao within others. By Spending 1 minute focusing, for the next 10 minutes, creatures of your level and lower within 120 feet of you, that can mold Chakra or aren’t suppressing their chakra, reveal their presence to you. This does not reveal their location, only that they are within your sensory range and granting you immunity to being Surprised and hidden creatures cannot make attacks at advantage against you. Once you use this special sense, you cannot do so again until you complete a rest.

Tao Attunement

11th Level Clan Feature

It is said that while Chakra was a creation of Shinobi, by Shinobi. Tao is much older and far more primordial in nature. The source of everything in existence, be it living or non-living. Most creatures go their entire lives never knowing Tao or how their lives are shaped by it. But the Yamada have learned to harness it after a botched mission under their homelands shogun. The Yamada now teach and train its more senior members in the ways of Tao, attuning them to one of five base Tao Principles, but unlike others, you have the unique ability to hold any affinity through meditation.

Select one of five Tao attributes gaining its benefits. You can switch this attunement when you complete a short rest.

Wood

When you regain or heal another creatures hit points, increase the amount by half your level, once per creature, per rest.

Additionally, when there are 2 or more hostile creatures within your Executioners Instrument’s range, if you take the Empty Blade attack against one of them, compare your attack result against the AC of up to 2 of them, treating each as if they were the original target.

Fire

You gain 2 ranks of Mastery to your initiative.

Once per turn, when you take the Dash or Disengage actions, you can make an Empty Blade attack with your Executioners Instrument as part of the action taken as if you were forgoing 2 attacks.

Earth

You gain advantage on checks and saves made to resist being moved or knocked prone.

Once per turn, you can forgo one attack granted by the Attack action to guard yourself, reducing the next instance of damage by an amount equal to your [Weapon Damage], before the beginning of your next turn.

Metal

When you roll a d6 as a result of the Empty Blade attack, you can trigger its effect on a 4, 5 or 6.

If you would miss your Empty Blade attack you can spend your Bonus Action to remake the attack.

Water

When a creature attempts to dash, disengage, grapple, disarm, shove or forcefully move you, while they are within your Executioners Instrument range, you can make one weapon attack against them.

Once per turn, when a creature within 30 feet of you attempts to attack an allied creature that is also, within 30 feet of you, you can spend your reaction to move up to your speed, ending it adjacent to your ally and attempting to parry the blow by rolling your [Weapon Damage] die and adding half the result to your allies AC. If the attacking creature misses, you deal your [Weapon Damage] to them.

The Middle Path

15th Level Clan Feature

As you reach the pinnacle of the Yamada clan, you have found that the absolutes they taught were merely limitations you’ve grown beyond.

By spending your Bonus Action as part of casting a Hijutsu you can use both your Ideal Cut and Tao abilities.

Once per turn, when making an Empty Blade attack, reduce the value needed to trigger its effect by 1.
